environment.description: Same FastAPI service deployed behind an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) in an ECS Fargate task. The Envoy configuration includes an HTTP connection manager filter chain with a Lua filter that appends a Content-Security-Policy response header on all text/html responses. The CSP directive specifies: script-src 'self' with require-sri-for script; additionally the Envoy route configuration includes a header_mutation policy that strips and re-writes the Location header on 302 responses, enforcing that redirect targets match a compiled RE2 pattern ^https://app\.example\.com/. The Envoy listener also has a ext_authz filter configured to validate CSRF tokens on POST requests to /oauth/consent by checking the Origin header against an allowlist and verifying a double-submit cookie pattern. The task IAM role has no outbound network permissions beyond the VPC endpoint for ECR and CloudWatch.

config.envoy_route_mutation: 302 Location header rewritten if not matching ^https://app\.example\.com/
config.envoy_ext_authz: CSRF validation on POST /oauth/consent (Origin + double-submit cookie)
config.network: awsvpc mode, security group allows inbound 443 only from ALB, egress restricted to VPC endpoints
config.tls: mTLS between ALB and Envoy sidecar
